summary: Targeted frontend re-verification (mobile 390x844, preview URL) of the iteration_4 CSS-color bug fix + regression sweep. ALL 4 previously-broken colour surfaces are now correct (computed styles): (1) QuickAddGrid tile icons = rgb(51,112,255) primary / rgb(68,213,128) chart-3 / rgb(255,74,61) chart-4, wrappers = color(srgb ... / 0.15) valid color-mix alpha (no longer rgba(0,0,0,0)); (2) DrillsPage 'High' intensity badge = color rgb(255,74,61) on bg color(srgb 1 0.29 0.24 / 0.15); (3) SkillRadarCard radar polygon stroke+fill = rgb(51,112,255) with fillOpacity 0.35, PolarRadiusAxis ticks count = 0 (hidden, no pile-up), 6 angle labels render (Serve/Forehand/Backhand/Volley/Footwork/Mental); (4) MacroDonut colours use var(--color-chart-*) - verified var() resolves inside SVG fill (rect fill var(--color-chart-3) -> rgb(68,213,128)); the donut itself could NOT be populated because api.createNutritionLog is a no-op stub without Supabase. CSS vars resolve correctly (--color-primary hsl(222 100% 60%), chart-3 hsl(145 63% 55%), chart-4 hsl(4 100% 62%)) and color-mix() is supported by the runtime browser. onCta: player with 2 matches shows [data-testid=skill-radar-cta] 'RATE YOUR LATEST MATCH ->' and clicking navigates to /history/m_qa_1 (latest match); player with 0 matches shows no CTA element (onCta null) - documented 'Play a match first' label is therefore never visible. Regressions re-confirmed: coach dashboard (QuickAddGrid + Streak + stat cards, 0 console errors), Drills add + list + badge + week stats (Drills 1 / High 1) with persistence, water tracker 500+500+250 = 1250/2500 ml 50% + 7-day avg 179ml, WeeklyAverageCard 3 tiles, H2H insight 'Rival One / 2 matches played / 1-1 / EVEN / Last: 6-4, 6-3 (W)', MatchSkillRating saves all 6 ratings (avg 8.0, persisted to tt.skills.<uid>) and survives reload via the new O(1) getSkillRatingsForMatch, and Dashboard SkillRadar then renders in blue. Nav drawer contains nav-item-drills for player (and coach, verified iteration_4 + drawer open OK). Zero non-429 console errors across /, /drills, /nutrition, /compare, /history/<id>, /player-dashboard?tab=overview|performance|analytics|progress.

ui_bugs.issue: Two remaining double-wrapped occurrences of the same fixed bug class were missed by the global replace: line 162 `outline: 2px solid hsl(var(--color-primary))` (focus-visible outline on all buttons/links -> invalid, keyboard focus ring not rendered in brand blue) and line 174 `background-color: hsl(var(--color-muted) / 0.5)` (table row hover -> no hover tint). --color-* already contain hsl(); should be `var(--color-primary)` and `color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-muted) 50%, transparent)`.

For a player with 0 matches, DashboardPage passes onCta={null} so the button is not rendered at all and the 'Play a match first' ctaLabel is dead code / never shown. If the label is meant to be visible, render a disabled button instead.
No data-testid attributes on the meal-log form fields/submit, so meal logging (and hence a populated MacroDonut) is not automatable.

integration_issues.issue: In mock (non-Supabase) mode src/api/index.js maps getNutritionLogs/createNutritionLog/deleteNutritionLog to no-op stubs (`async () => {}`), so submitting the meal form silently does nothing, no error is shown, and Today's Macros/Weekly Average can never leave the empty state. MacroDonut slice colours could only be verified indirectly (var() resolves in SVG fill).

All tabs render only 'No ranking history found yet. Once your rankings sync, your segments will appear here.' for a fresh player with seeded matches - content is gated behind AITA segment/ranking data, so the 58 globally-replaced inline colours in player/MyPerformanceTab, OverviewTab, MatchAnalyticsTab, ProgressTab could NOT be exercised with real data. Source grep confirms 0 remaining `hsl(var(--color-` in those files and DOM scan found 0 leftover double-wrapped inline styles, but visual chart verification is still pending.

issues: Rapid sequential SPA navigations triggered ~40 HTTP 429 responses on /src/*.js module requests, leaving /player-dashboard rendered blank once. Recovered on a slower retry - dev-server/proxy rate limiting, not app code, but it makes automated multi-page runs flaky.

action_items: Fix the last 2 `hsl(var(--color-*))` occurrences in src/index.css (lines 162, 174).
Decide on SkillRadarCard no-match state: render a disabled CTA so 'Play a match first' is actually visible, or drop the label.

Nutrition logging is a no-op without Supabase - either back it with localStorage (like drills/water/skills) or show an explicit 'not available in demo mode' state; today the form silently discards input and MacroDonut can never populate.
critical_code_review_comments: src/index.css still contains the invalid nested-hsl pattern that was fixed everywhere else - add a lint/grep guard (e.g. CI grep for 'hsl(var(--color-') to prevent reintroduction.
NutritionPage calls api.createNutritionLog which resolves to `async () => {}` in mock mode; the UI treats that as success. Add a capability check or mock implementation.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of the 8 requested checks verified pass (MacroDonut verified indirectly; player-tab charts verified at source/DOM level only)

context_for_next_testing_agent: localStorage is clean each browser_automation run: sign up a player in-script (Sign Up tab needs BOTH password inputs), read userId from localStorage 'mtp_mock_session_v1' (.userId), then write matches to 'mtp_mock_matches_v1' and ratings to 'tt.skills.<userId>' and reload. Drills/water also under tt.drills|water.<userId>. Colour assertions: use getComputedStyle - valid alpha now shows as 'color(srgb r g b / 0.15)' not rgba(). /player-dashboard tabs need AITA segment/ranking data to render charts (all empty otherwise) - find a seed path for segments if those charts must be visually verified. Nutrition logs cannot be seeded (mock API stub). Avoid >5 rapid page.goto calls per run: the dev server returns 429 and pages render blank.
rca_of_the_issue: Iteration_4 bug root cause: --color-* tokens are already full hsl() colours, so inline `hsl(var(--color-x))` produced invalid CSS and fell back to transparent/white. Main agent's fix (direct var() + color-mix for alpha) is correct and verified via computed styles; only src/index.css was missed by the replace.
